MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Fair & Square feels like a natural next choice because its acoustic storytelling connects with what draws me to Jonathan Edwards, Melanie, and Simon & Garfunkel.",
    "All the Roadrunning fits my interest in warm melodies and expressive singing, while Actually connects with the pop side of my listening even though I would choose something more acoustic now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Rainbow: Live in Munich 1977 and The Razors Edge share a rock connection with some of my listening, but their harder sound misses the gentler melodies I currently want. If Nola is Down's album, it has the same mismatch.",
    "The Back Room's darker sound does not offer the warmth I am seeking, and Crime Mob gives me little reason to expect the melodic listening I want.",
    "Pioneer and Romeo & Juliet are too ambiguous for me to connect them to my interests confidently; I would pass because I cannot identify the recordings."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in classic rock seems to have been treated as interest in harder rock too, although familiar melodies matter more to me than that broad connection.",
    "My occasional pop choices seem to have been stretched into a broader appetite for different sounds than I would actually choose during this visit."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection among Jonathan Edwards, Melanie, and Simon & Garfunkel is acoustic warmth, clear melodies, and storytelling; those qualities would make me more likely to choose something.",
    "My repeated visits to best-of collections suggest that recognizable songs matter to me, so an unfamiliar recording needs a clearer connection to my taste before I would choose it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in melodic music, but stretched my rock interests beyond the warm, acoustic storytelling I want right now."
}
